title: docs(agents): AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md rules only — narratives, dates and quotations out; issue ownership written by role
body:
Fixes #15670, fixes #15125, fixes #14913, fixes #14509, fixes #15241, fixes #15357
Part of #15379
#15287 remains open until its rule is readable on `main`: the ownership paragraph in this PR is now its only carrier (PR #15290 was closed by the maintainer as superseded); its three criteria are rows 30a–30c of the inventory below.

Family member 5 of the rules-only rewrite (maintainer ruling recorded on #15379: 「各条规则的出处叙事、事故复盘 根本不重要啊，不需要写入skills啊」). `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` keep every rule as one executable sentence in its own section and its own register; every incident retelling, provenance story, ruling date, verbatim quotation and "why we learned this" leaves. The ownership paragraph is rewritten by role under the 2026-09-05 ruling on issue ownership (「待你定 1（情形 C）: agent 无法区分是你还是 PM 可以接受」 / 「待你定 2（情形 H 与配额）: 暂时不区分」). Six cards fold in as one rule each. Ceilings move down only.

**Governed surfaces** (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `scripts/pm/**`) — draft PR, human merge; `skip-changeset` (nothing publishes). No model identifier appears in the diff, this body, the commit or the comments.
